description: Found while proposing fz-sc8.14, which creates lib/tuple.fz with to_list/1 only. Elixir's Tuple also has append/2, delete_at/2, duplicate/2, insert_at/3, product/1 and sum/1 (Tuple.__info__(:functions) on 1.19.4). Four of them build a tuple whose size is known only at runtime, which needs a tuple-from-list primitive fz does not have (List.to_tuple/1 is missing too). Build that primitive once, write the four over it, and product/sum over elem/2. Oracle fixtures on interp, run and build.
title: Tuple's remaining surface: append, delete_at, duplicate, insert_at, product, sum
